job_description:
Join our AI team as a Machine Learning Engineer and help build cutting-edge ML solutions that impact millions of users. You'll work on developing, deploying, and scaling machine learning models in production environments.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement machine learning models for production systems
- Build data pipelines for training and inference
- Optimize model performance and scalability
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize research
- Monitor and maintain ML systems in production
- Conduct A/B tests and analyze model performance
- Stay current with latest ML research and techniques

Qualifications:
- 3+ years of machine learning engineering experience
- Strong programming skills in Python
- Experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
- Knowledge of MLOps practices and tools
- Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop)
- Understanding of software engineering best practices
- MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field preferred

Benefits include health insurance, 401k matching, stock options, unlimited PTO, and remote work options.
